results.title: Top Swiss court upholds landmark Liberia war crimes ruling

results.title: Police forward Ashie Moore case docket to AG for prosecution over alleged theft
results.content: The Ghana Police Service has forwarded the case docket involving Greater Accra Regional Chairman of the ruling National Democratic Congress (NDC), Emmanuel Nii Ashie Moore, to the Attorney-General's Department for prosecution over allegations of stealing from a Singaporean businessman. The forwarding of the docket, with a covering letter dated October 28, 2026, marks a new development in a case that has been under police investigation since 2025, and in which the Attorney-General's Department had, as far back as March 16, 2026, advised that Mr Ashie Moore be prosecuted. Ashie Moore, on the other hand, has vehemently denied any wrongdoing, insisting that the allegations constitute a smear campaign against his political acumen.

results.title: Tilly Akua Nipaa appointed Communications Director of RANA
results.content: The Rights Accountability Network Africa (RANA) has appointed Ghanaian media personality and public relations professional Matilda Mensah Marfo, popularly known as Tilly Akua Nipaa, as its Communications Director. The appointment, announced on Sunday, November 1, 2026, is aimed at strengthening the organisation's institutional communications, expanding public engagement and making human rights advocacy more accessible to citizens across Ghana and the African continent. Tilly Akua Nipaa has built a career in broadcasting, corporate communications, media relations, brand storytelling and stakeholder engagement. She has worked as a broadcaster and panellist on platforms under Despite Media and the Multimedia Group. She currently serves as Head of Public Relations and Marketing at Crux Global, where she leads the company's strategic communications and marketing initiatives.

results.title: Ablakwa and the Evacuation of the Unborn
results.content: Once upon a time in the Republic of Uncommon Sense, our commitment to future generations became so impressive that we began evacuating citizens before they were born. Other countries were making plans for 2034 and 2036. We were already bringing their inhabitants home from South Africa. For years, politicians had been accused of doing nothing for the unborn. Here, at last, was documentary evidence that the unborn had benefited from foreign policy. Somewhere, a couple yet to meet could apparently rest assured that their future child had already escaped xenophobia.

results.title: Sand contractors seek regulatory clarity over enforcement operations at Dawa
results.content: The Sand and Stone Contractors Association of Ghana has called on state authorities to clarify the regulatory procedures governing sand-winning and transportation activities at Dawa and neighbouring communities. The Association says uncertainty surrounding enforcement operations, documentation requirements and the issuance of fines is creating difficulties for sand winners and tipper truck operators and requires urgent attention from the relevant institutions. In a petition signed by its Acting National Chairman, Anthony Mensah, the Association said it had approached several state institutions, including the Minerals Commission, the Ghana Military Police, the Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ), the Tema Regional Police Command and the Member of Parliament for Ningo-Prampram, Samuel Nartey George, to seek intervention.
